subject: general
question: The factors of a² - 1 - 2x - x² are _______.
solution:
Formula Used:

(a2 - b2) = (a + b)(a - b)

Calculation:

a2 - 1 - 2x - x2 

⇒ a2 - (1 + 2x + x2)

By using (a2 - b2) = (a + b)(a - b),

⇒ a2 - (1 + 2x + x2) = (a + 1 + x) (a - 1 - x)

∴ **The correct option is 2 i.e. (a + 1 + x) (a - 1 - x).**
